rounds.mechanism: Halting has exactly one local cause: eat-through (d=1 next to a chunk) of a chunk with an odd (10)-run. Reachable frames satisfy the parity rules G1-G5: G1 Z and inner-Y (10)-runs even; G2 a0 odd in edge mode; G3 walls p=q mod 2, at most one odd wall, and if there is one then P is odd; G4 the eat cascade (e,s)=(ak,d) mod 2, where a merge needs e=0 and an eat sets e+=B, s=c+1; G5 ak even in P-mode with walls. Magnitudes do not matter, because same-parity perturbations never halt. The right phase is now in closed form: from a hub or P-mode right end with last run ak and S=max staircase level <= ak-1, HubClean (ak<2S-1) gives walls (a0-1,2b1),(a1,2b2),... and a bouncer start (ak-S, S-1); HubTop (ak=S_next-1) drops the last wall (p,q) and starts at (p-1, q+ak). G1-G5 alone are not closed: closure also needs the underflow inequality (a P-mode bouncer with walls reaches its wall first), d>=4 at Push, and the exact relation ak+d = S-1 carried by BounceP, AbsorbChain and RightEnd (Push/merge carry it in chunks), which makes every right end clean or top. These are identities and linear inequalities, not pseudo-random arithmetic, so the machine is not a cryptid. They do rule out a generic DFA/CTL certificate.

rounds.mechanism: Each right end is one sequence z: its walls (p_i, q_i), far to near, plus a virtual last wall for the start frame ((t-S+1, S-1) clean, (p_m, q_m+t) top). With tail sums B(k) = sum_{l>=k} (-1)^l z_l and tau = S-1 (clean) or t (top), the left traversal is a stack process whose running excess is T_i = 1 + B(2i-1). So B(odd k>=3) >= 0 is the underflow inequality (no P-mode right end with walls), and B(1) < 0 means a collapse. Every transition from blank is growth G (prepend h = 5 + B(1) - e, e in {0,1}; B'(k) = 2 tau - B(k-1)), collapse C (B(1) < 0; head replaced by the odd pair (P-2, 2b1+1)) or short S (a new block seed). Interior B's satisfy exact zipper relations (k even: B(k) = 2B(k+1)+4+e; k odd: B(k) = 2B(k+1)-2tau-4-e; e = B(k+1) mod 2), which the shift-reflection maps onto each other. So a block is fixed by its tail, its deviations double with alternating sign (h_(n+1) = 2h_(n-1) - h_n), and it ends when B(1) < 0. H* = parity + staircase + band 0 <= B(k) <= 2 tau + zipper relations. It is closed over one traversal on 10^4 random hubs (target met) and over 40 traversals at levels >= 10^9. It leaks only through small-value corner events (9 families, unruled) and a too-wide clause for short right ends. Linear throughout, so not a cryptid.
